description: This Java class implements a factory for creating Kafka publisher actors within the Eclipse Ditto framework, following the singleton pattern. It provides methods to retrieve an actor name and to create Props objects configured with connection details.

classes.name: DefaultKafkaPublisherActorFactory
classes.description: A singleton factory class responsible for creating instances of Kafka publisher actors, providing actor names and actor Props configurations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the factory, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: getActorName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier used for Kafka publisher actors.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns an Akka Props object configured with a connection, factory, and dry run flag for creating Kafka publisher actors.
